name: servexservices
description: ServeXservices — Vite SPA (client/) plus the Express API, deployed as one Vercel project.
//: Vercel installs dependencies from the project root only. The list below mirrors the runtime dependencies in server/package.json so that api/index.js — and the server/ modules it imports — resolve when the function is bundled. It is duplicated, not shared: keep the two in sync when adding a server runtime dependency. Swapping both packages to npm workspaces would remove the duplication, but it changes how `npm ci` behaves in the client/ and server/ subdirectories, which the Dockerfile relies on.
